newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand kills four Moslem bandits in shootout.
newsitem.headline: Thailand kills four Moslem bandits in shootout.

text.p: Thai paratroopers shot dead four Moslem bandits on Thursday in the jungle on the border with Malaysia, police said.
The bandits were intercepted near Srisakorn village in Narathiwat province, about 1,500 km (915 miles) south of Bangkok, police said.

The dead were believed to be members of Thailand's Barisan Revolusi Nasional, a faction of the now defunct Pattani United Liberation Organisation (PULO) which thrives on extortion and harassment of businessmen in the area, a police official told Reuters.
PULO was formed in the 1960s by Moslem fundamentalists and fought for independence for the four predominantly Moslem southern provinces of Pattani, Satun, Yala and Narathiwat.
